data.creator_notes:
Love the original a lot: Simple, yet packs a lot of heat. She inspired me to make my own first card, Aratel, as something of a rival.  Check my profile if interested.

But I wanted to be able to skip the initial phase where you don't own her yet, just get right down to business.  Unfortunately, intros are what I have the most problem with writing...

I might make an Aratel-specific intro or two for group chats at some point.  No promises.
